name: Naboth
title: Owner of the Vineyard from Jezreel
summary: Naboth was a man from Jezreel who owned a vineyard next to King Ahab's palace. He refused to sell or exchange his inheritance in accordance with God's law, and was subsequently killed through an evil conspiracy led by Queen Jezebel. His unjust death triggered God's judgment against Ahab's dynasty.

keyEvents.title: Ahab Desires Naboth's Vineyard
keyEvents.description: King Ahab wanted to buy or exchange for Naboth's vineyard, which was located next to his palace in Jezreel, so that he could turn it into a vegetable garden.

keyEvents.title: Naboth Refuses to Sell His Ancestral Inheritance
keyEvents.description: Naboth refused to give up his ancestral inheritance to the king, in accordance with the Mosaic Law which forbade the permanent sale of tribal inherited land. He said: "The Lord keep me from giving you my ancestral inheritance!"

keyEvents.title: Jezebel's Evil Plot
keyEvents.description: Queen Jezebel arranged a false trial against Naboth by sending letters in Ahab's name to the elders of the city, instructing them to procure two false witnesses who would accuse Naboth of blaspheming God and the king.

keyEvents.title: Naboth's Execution
keyEvents.description: Naboth was falsely accused and stoned to death outside the city, based on the lying testimony of false witnesses. He suffered a martyr's death because he held fast to God's law concerning his ancestral inheritance.

keyEvents.title: Elijah's Judgment Against Ahab
keyEvents.description: The prophet Elijah was sent by God to confront Ahab in Naboth's vineyard with a severe judgment: dogs would lick up Ahab's blood in the same place where they had licked up Naboth's blood, and Jezebel would be devoured by dogs.

keyEvents.title: Fulfillment of Judgment Against Ahab's House
keyEvents.description: God's judgment against Ahab's house was fulfilled when Jehu carried out the sentence. Jehu ordered that Joram's body be thrown onto Naboth's plot of land, and Jezebel was thrown from a window and devoured by dogs, just as had been prophesied.
